messages:
maria: FYI got an alert from our KMS usage anomaly rule — unusual signing from a service account in prod at 03:12 UTC. looks like low-volume but consistent calls.
aj: Can you paste the alert? which key and SA?
maria: alert: KMS_KEY_ID=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/ingest-sign, service_account=svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com, src_ip=34.82.10.5
samir: 34.82.10.5 is one of our GKE egress IPs but not one used by ingest. Hmm.
claire: any successful ops tied to that key? signing vs decrypt?
maria: signing only. It was used to sign JWTs for an internal consumer (ingest). No decrypt calls.
henry: possible compromised SA key or perm bump. Did we see new IAM grants?
maria: checking IAM audit logs... quick paste from audit:
```
2026-02-18T03:11:56Z iam.serviceAccountKeys.create serviceAccount=svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com actor=ops-automation@redwood
2026-02-18T03:12:01Z kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign resource=ingest-sign actor=svc-ingest-prod@redwood
```
aj: so an SA key was created right before uses. who created the key? ops-automation svc?
maria: ops-automation has a job that rotates keys for some tenants but not for this SA. ticket SEC-481 flagged that job earlier.
samir: if ops-automation created it, trace the automation run id. ops, can you check?
ops: ops: saw a run `rotate-keys-20260218-03` that targeted a different project but the job selector regex matched our SA due to a misconfigured pattern. I’m pulling logs.
incident-bot: Incident SEC-2026-02-18-KMS: Created. Severity: medium. Notifying oncall.
claire: OK containment: revoke the SA key, revoke active tokens signed with it (if possible), rotate the KMS signing key if we can't trust JWTs.
henry: we can revoke the SA key via iam.serviceAccounts.keys.delete. tokens already issued won't be revoked unless we check JWT exp or maintain token revocation list. Short-term: set ingress consumers to reject tokens signed by that key id.
maria: done: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable <KEY_ID>` -> confirmed.
aj: thanks. Next: post-incident tasks and tabletop follow-ups. I think we need: 1) fix rotate-job regex 2) add a pre-deploy dry-run for ops-automation 3) RBAC change: restrict ops-automation from creating SA keys outside its namespace 4) audit rule: alert on any service account key creation in prod that isn't whitelisted.
samir: add KMS: rotate signing key and publish key-version fingerprint to consumers. also update console docs about signing key usage.
claire: I'll own RBAC change. Assigning to @claire, due EOD 2026-02-19. Will open PR to iam-policy repo.
henry: I'll own the KMS rotation + consumer rollout. Henry -> due 2026-02-20. Will coordinate with infra for zero-downtime.
aj: I'll own the ops-automation fix + adding a dry-run flag enforced by CI. Aj -> due 2026-02-19.
maria: I'll add new audit rules and write a playbook entry for this flow (detection -> revoke -> rotate). Maria -> due 2026-02-21.
samir: vuln triage: do we treat this as a security bug in ops tooling? I'd say yes. Move to backlog as P0 for ops-automation repo.
claire: AGREED. Ticket created SEC-482: "ops-automation key-rotation regex allows cross-project SA key creation". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-482
maria: also logging/observability follow-up: increase KMS audit retention to 400 days and add parsed fields to our SIEM to surface key create/use counts per SA.
ops: note — increasing retention will need a cost approval from finance. I'll put a cost estimate in SEC-482.
henry: tabletop: we should run a focused tabletop covering SA key misuse and consumer token revocation. propose 2026-02-26 16:00 UTC.
aj: works for me.
samir: works.
claire: works.
maria: I'll prep a 30-min scenario doc + checklist. publishing in #eng-security/playbooks the week before.
incident-bot: Action items created: SEC-482, SEC-483, SEC-484 (see thread). Reminders set for owners.
aj: quick checklist we should add to the playbook:
- immediate: disable SA key, block signer in ingress, notify consumers
- triage: audit who created key, check automation runs, check other SAs touched
- remediate: fix automation, rotate KMS key, adjust RBAC, update docs
- post: tabletop, update runbooks, adjust alerts
maria: any objections to enforcing a policy that denies iam.serviceAccountKeys.create outside a trusted automation principal? we can whitelist ops-automation and the deploy-bot only.
henry: strong +1. reduces blast radius.
claire: I'll propose changes to IAM policy and test in staging first.
samir: one more: add a periodic scan to detect service accounts that have key material older than X days or keys created outside our rotation pipeline.
aj: good. add to Optimize backlog (or rather Security backlog). I'll make SEC-483 for that scan.
maria: final note: make sure KMS key labels include owner/team and expected consumers — that'll make detection easier.
ops: copying notes into the incident runbook now.
maria: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the PRs land and before the tabletop. :thumbsup:
claire: ping me if you need policy snippets. I have a draft deny-rule.
henry: will post rotation playbook link once ready.
ops: logs uploaded: gs://redwood-incident-logs/SEC-2026-02-18/ — perms restricted.
samir: closing loop: assign retrospective owner to summarize lessons. Maria, can you do a one-pager for all-hands next week?
maria: yep, will draft and circulate by 2026-02-22.
aj: thanks team. :rocket:
